odmt-clicker.config.title: ODMT Clicker
odmt-clicker.config.subtitle: Press ↓ in game to open this menu
odmt-clicker.config.mode.tooltip:
Key: turn ON/OFF with your bound key.
AUTO: turns on by itself when you click fast and stays on until you stop.
odmt-clicker.config.key.tooltip:
Click, then press any key. ESC = unbind.
Not available in AUTO mode.
odmt-clicker.config.cps.tooltip: Each click gets a random speed from the Min-Max range.
odmt-clicker.config.hold.tooltip:
ON: when enabled, clicks only while you hold left mouse button.
OFF: clicks nonstop while enabled.
odmt-clicker.config.hud.tooltip: Shows Auto: ON / Auto: OFF above the hotbar.
odmt-clicker.config.trigger.tooltip: AUTO: how many fast clicks start the autoclicker.
odmt-clicker.config.window.tooltip:
AUTO: the start clicks must fit in this time.
Lower = you need to click faster.
odmt-clicker.config.timeout.tooltip: AUTO: turns off when you stop clicking for this long.
odmt-clicker.config.auto_tool.tooltip:
While mining, switches to the best tool from your hotbar.
Inactive while the autoclicker is clicking.
odmt-clicker.config.return_slot.tooltip: After mining, goes back to the slot you had before.
odmt-clicker.config.protect.tooltip: Won't use a tool that is about to break.
